description: Spec001 identity, allocation and progression registry transcribed from SPEC.md, selecting all twelve actual authored gameplay room records. Authored interactions do not certify finished scenes, media or release acceptance. Editable media sources, actual placement and human review remain separate production work.

rooms.name: The Arrival Lift
rooms.purpose: Guest introduction; inspect an unlit link and distinguish power from communication

rooms.name: The Titan's Workshop
rooms.purpose: Central briefing, notebook, tool bench, recruit/team management, branching route map

rooms.name: The Copper Warrens
rooms.purpose: Inspect continuity, stated cable limits, pairing and interference; choose a repair

rooms.name: The Echo Cavern
rooms.purpose: Compare signal before/after regeneration and distinguish regeneration from repairing a broken medium

rooms.name: The Photon Gardens
rooms.purpose: Discover light transmission; inspect dirty/broken connectors and select compatible fiber

rooms.name: The Prism Vault
rooms.purpose: Calculate a supplied optical loss budget; match optics, fiber, and wavelength

rooms.name: The Skywell
rooms.purpose: Align a wireless link; inspect path, channel and signal/noise evidence

rooms.name: The Storm Observatory
rooms.purpose: Diagnose interference, compare candidate channels, validate a new observation

rooms.name: The Shell Market
rooms.purpose: Choose compatible modules; distinguish media, form factor, PHY and power requirements

rooms.name: The Clockworks
rooms.purpose: Decode a scoped toy signal, align timing, compare common link capabilities

rooms.name: The Backhoe Rift
rooms.purpose: Gather failure evidence; execute and validate a branch-specific restoration plan

rooms.name: The Iron Threshold
rooms.purpose: Independently verify link recovery; choose permanent restoration or a documented temporary bridge; epilogue

objectives.name: Read the silent link in R01
objectives.completionEvidence: Record power indication and link indication separately; perform a valid inspection

objectives.name: Open the investigation in R02
objectives.completionEvidence: Identify the known-good endpoints and the physical path under test; pin a hypothesis

objectives.name: Prepare copper in R03
objectives.completionEvidence: Choose a compatible, within-limit cable path and remove the diagnosed physical defect

objectives.name: Prove copper in R04
objectives.completionEvidence: Compare before/after measurements and reject a repeater as a cure for a severed cable

objectives.name: Prepare fiber in R05
objectives.completionEvidence: Match the supplied optic/fiber profiles and inspect the connection before changing it

objectives.name: Prove fiber in R06
objectives.completionEvidence: Show the optical receive level is inside the stated receiver range with the required margin

objectives.name: Prepare radio in R07
objectives.completionEvidence: Establish a viable path and compatible radio settings in the supplied scenario

objectives.name: Prove radio in R08
objectives.completionEvidence: Select a channel/path meeting the scenario threshold and confirm a fresh measurement

objectives.name: Equip the repair in R09
objectives.completionEvidence: Select the route's required compatible module/tools and verify its supplied power constraints

objectives.name: Calibrate in R10
objectives.completionEvidence: Decode a toy bit pattern and distinguish timing/physical compatibility from address discovery

objectives.name: Resolve the intervention in R11
objectives.completionEvidence: Execute a reviewed copper, fiber or radio plan, or deliberately isolate an unresolved defect; record the result and any temporary dependency

objectives.name: Validate at R12
objectives.completionEvidence: Repeat link measurements and endpoint test; classify permanent repair, temporary restoration, or unresolved fault

characters.name: Blue Dragon
characters.role: Short-range radio exhibit and dialogue; R07

characters.name: Celestial Eagle
characters.role: Satellite-distance perspective, not a required satellite simulator; R08

characters.name: Iron Golem
characters.role: PHY and interface compatibility mentor; R02/R12

characters.name: QSFP Chimera
characters.role: Multi-lane/form-factor explanation with profile caveats; R09

characters.name: Metronome Golem
characters.role: Signal timing and toy decoding; R10

characters.name: Noise Demon
characters.role: Visible consequence of impaired radio evidence; R08

optionalActivities.name: The Antique Serial Post in R04
optionalActivities.benefit: Help the Tortoise deliver a short message; discover serial concepts and a journal illustration

optionalActivities.name: The Eel's Energy Audit in R09
optionalActivities.benefit: Diagnose an over-budget power plan; gain a cosmetic workshop decoration

optionalActivities.name: The Skywell Weather Diary in R08
optionalActivities.benefit: Compare two time-separated observations; unlock a deeper radio explanation

optionalActivities.name: The Lost Maintenance Record across R03/R05/R09
optionalActivities.benefit: Combine clues in the notebook; change the epilogue's maintenance report

optionalActivities.name: Clockworks Bit Loom
optionalActivities.benefit: Decode toy symbols with optional untimed practice; no score blocks O10

optionalActivities.name: Prism Budget Bench
optionalActivities.benefit: Experiment with loss components and margins after O06

optionalActivities.name: Channel Scout
optionalActivities.benefit: Predict, measure, and compare interference scenarios after O08
